welcome.title: Welcome to Abyss
welcome.intro: Abyss plays music from your TIDAL account or from files on your PC. It is an independent project: TIDAL did not make it. You can repeat this guide in Settings.
welcome.service_help: TIDAL is a paid music streaming service, and you need your own account. Or listen to files on your computer with no account at all.
welcome.risk_title: Before you sign in with TIDAL
welcome.risk_body: Abyss is unofficial. It signs in using identifiers that belong to TIDAL's own apps, and TIDAL has not approved this use. TIDAL could suspend your account or block Abyss. Use it at your own risk. Local files never use an account.
welcome.library_help: Add a folder or audio files. You can also do this later in Settings. Your originals stay in place.
welcome.repeat_help: Repeat the introduction, choose a listening service, language or local folder.
lastfm.title: Last.fm
lastfm.description: Send what you play to your Last.fm profile. Last.fm receives the artist, title, album, length and time of each listen.
lastfm.status_connecting: Waiting for you to allow Abyss in your browser
lastfm.sync_help: Sends your saved Replay history (TIDAL listens) to Last.fm. It runs in the background and can take a while.
lastfm.scrobble_help: Send each track you play, from TIDAL or local files, once you have heard half of it or 4 minutes.
lastfm.session_expired: Your Last.fm session expired. Connect again.
lastfm.not_available: Last.fm is not available in this build.
eq.title: Equalizer
eq.tab_description: Parametric filters applied before the output
eq.description: A chain of filters, like Equalizer APO. When it is off, empty or does nothing, the audio is not processed at all.
eq.enable_help: Apply the filter chain and the pre-amp to everything you play.
eq.status_idle: Bit-perfect: the equalizer is not processing the audio
eq.status_active: Equalizer active: the audio is processed (not bit-perfect)
eq.preamp_help: Gain applied before the filters. Use a negative value to avoid clipping when you boost.
eq.filters_description: Applied in this order. Up to 32.
eq.empty: No filters yet. Add one to start.
eq.auto_preamp_help: Sets the pre-amp from the loudest point of the filters every time they change, so boosts do not clip.
eq.clip: Over full scale: {0} dBFS (lower the pre-amp)
eq.select_hint: Select a filter to adjust it with sliders.
